probe_floor_sensitivity.reason: periodicity NPZ files omit original pilot probe train/test states, tags and feature scales; two histories cannot supply that assay

query_adapter_validation.reason: native query predictions saved; manual query prediction array absent, so saved manual/native query scalar cannot be independently recomputed

measurement.closure: Last adjacent pair of 13 phase-matched complete states; global absolute AND relative AND coordinate bounds; R1 unavailable.
measurement.pre_query_separation: Absolute Euclidean norm of paired native one-step complete-state difference; no centering or scale normalization.
measurement.precision: Fixed weights and literal FP32 inputs; separate native FP32/FP64 dynamics from zero. FP64 is not merely product accumulation.
measurement.sampling: Within-checkpoint deterministic measurements; driver ranges are not confidence intervals. Control source prefixes are shared across horizons except for forced terminal motifs, so complete bodies need not be nested.
measurement.tangents: Last 12 body steps at R2/R16, cue zero, differentiated manual adapter; finite-time products only.
measurement.ulp: Absolute coordinate difference divided by maximum absolute local np.spacing of the saved coordinates; not integer representable-value distance.

source.hash_convention: Original report hash is coordinator-verified remote bytes; canonical embedded hash uses sorted compact JSON.

unavailable: Independent manual/native query-output comparison: manual query arrays absent.
Original probe feature-floor re-reduction: probe train/test clouds absent.
Useful covariance dimension and independent training-seed uncertainty.
Current checkpoint byte rehash by this reducer (frozen identity checked; separate coordinator evidence required).
